**Step Title: Segments with $$1$$ or $$2$$ letters have no meaning, which N-gram would capture as "words".**

**Hint 1:** Consider the biological significance of DNA sequences. Codons, which are meaningful in DNA, consist of exactly $$3$$ letters. Any sequence shorter than this does not correspond to a codon and thus lacks biological meaning.

**Hint 2:** Think about how N-grams work. When using N-grams with N up to $$3$$, sequences of $$1$$ or $$2$$ letters are still considered as potential "words" in the encoding process, even though they do not have any meaningful interpretation in the context of DNA.
